findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ means Sentinel members now pickle via the default Enum reduction, which serializes the object() value rather than the member name.
findings.rationale: Trigger: pickling an object that holds UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE, then unpickling it. Mechanism: the default Enum reduce stores the member's value, which is a bare object(); on load the fresh object is passed to Sentinel(...) and does not match any member, so it raises ValueError. Impact: round-tripping click objects containing these sentinels through pickle crashes, where the removed code had reconstructed the singleton by name.
